prompt: A cinematic high-angle view of a bustling modern city street corner. In the center, a sun-drenched outdoor cafe with white minimalist decor and glass walls glows under intense midday sun. Photorealistic, architectural photography, 8k, sharp focus, noir atmosphere, tension between light and dark.
